left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Dysfunctional lipids, [OR]  blood pressure  [AND] and glycemic control determined at a screening visit:
       -  Triglycerides  [OR] > 150 mg/dL OR HDL <50 in females, <40 mg/dL in males
       -  Systolic blood pressure  [OR] ≥130 mmHg OR diastolic blood pressure  [OR] ≥80 mmHg (or on hypertension medication)
       -  HbA1c ≥5

right.raw_text:
7% or higher
  -  No diagnosis or treatment for cancer in the past year
  -  No diagnosis of mild cognitive impairment  [OR] or dementia in the past year
  -  Ability to perform daily exercise, including aerobic activity and resistance exercise
  -  Non-smoker in the past year
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Positive exercise stress test
